degradation_evidence.before: FLAC__NO_SANITIZE_SIGNED_INTEGER_OVERFLOW macro guarded with #ifdef, only applied when old macro was defined
degradation_evidence.impact: Signed integer overflow sanitizer behavior in hotspot functions now controlled by build configuration

gap_introduced.description: Build-time sanitizer configuration changed; hotspots now opt-out of UBSAN signed overflow in fuzzing builds
gap_introduced.harness_needs_update: Yes - harness built without updated macro logic will miss sanitizer annotations, changing detection behavior

rationale: Sanitizer configuration controls what the fuzzer can detect. Changing which overflows are sanitized changes the set of detectable bugs.

verification.method: Code inspection of fixed.c, lpc.c, stream_decoder.c
